Class SimulatorController

java.lang.Object
controller.SimulatorController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Runnable
public class SimulatorController extends Object implements Runnable, Serializable
Controller class responsible for managing the simulation of the railway system. Handles the execution, pausing, resuming, and stopping of simulations, as well as processing financial results and managing train operations. This controller implements Runnable and Serializable to support concurrent execution and object persistence. It manages the simulation lifecycle, including: - Train operations and cargo management - Industry processing and cargo generation - Financial calculations and budget management - Historical event processing - UI updates and user feedback
